responsibility_name: Have morning coffee ready at eight

evidence.evidence_text: If it's 8:00, turn on the electric coffee maker in the kitchen.

coding.rationale: Timed trigger at 8:00 to have coffee ready; device (coffee maker) is implementation, outcome is prepared morning coffee.

evidence.evidence_text: When a certain food is missing in the fridge, send a notification and add the product to the shopping list on the fridge LED.

coding.rationale: Detects missing food and triggers replenishment via shopping list; failure is running out of needed items.

evidence.evidence_text: If the smart beer dispenser detects that the content of the current boiler is less than 50% and the reserve stock is less than 2 boilers then it will be automatically added to the Google Home shopping list Refill Beer ” also sending a notification to the stored phone ""Added 'Recharge Beer' to Google shopping list"

coding.rationale: Low-level thresholds trigger restock of beverage supply; failure is depletion of the drink stock.

responsibility_name: keep the household stocked with usual foods

evidence.evidence_text: WHEN user NOT at home IF the fridge is empty SEND the user an SMS reminding him to go shopping with the list of foods he usually eats

coding.rationale: Empty fridge while away prompts shopping reminder for usual foods; failure is food shortage at home.

responsibility_name: Ensure comfortable room temperature before waking

evidence.evidence_text: Ten minutes before the alarm sounds, the air conditioner is activated and will switch off as soon as the room temperature is the one preset by the user.

coding.rationale: Preconditions the room ahead of wake time to a preset comfort temperature; failure is waking to an uncomfortable room.

responsibility_name: Ensure the room is warm after showering

evidence.evidence_text: When I finish taking a shower, turn on the stove in the room at 25°.

coding.rationale: After the shower event, heat the room to prevent post-shower chill; failure is thermal discomfort.

evidence.evidence_text: While the user is cooking using the hob, the hood switches on automatically.

coding.rationale: Automatic extraction during cooking maintains air quality; failure is lingering fumes, odors, and discomfort.
